title: Resetting Your Password & Account Recovery
summary: Step-by-step guidance to regain access to your Spotify account using verified email or password reset link.
diagnostic_steps: Go to the password reset page at spotify.com/password-reset
Enter your registered email address or username
Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the password reset link
If traveling abroad for >14 days on a Free account, update country settings or upgrade to Premium

title: Managing Your Subscription & Charges
summary: Official Spotify billing terms, cancellation confirmation, and payment dispute guidelines.
diagnostic_steps: Log in to your account page at spotify.com/account to verify active subscription status
Check Receipts tab to confirm the exact billing date and card charged
If subscribed through Apple or Google, cancel directly in your device app store subscriptions
If charged after cancelling, verify whether you have a secondary active account under a different email

title: Fixing Audio Stuttering, Pausing & Buffering
summary: Diagnostic troubleshooting for tracks that pause, skip, buffer, or fail to produce sound.
diagnostic_steps: Check your internet connection and toggle WiFi off and on
Toggle Hardware Acceleration off in Spotify Desktop settings (Settings -> Show Advanced Settings)
Log out and log back in to refresh your streaming session token
Ensure Spotify is excluded from battery saver or background data restrictions on mobile

title: Offline Listening & Managing Storage Cache
summary: Rules for downloading playlists, maintaining offline storage, and clearing local application cache.
diagnostic_steps: Verify you have an active Premium plan and have gone online within the last 30 days
Check available device storage (at least 1GB of free space recommended)
In the Spotify app, go to Settings -> Storage -> Clear Cache
Re-toggle the Download switch on your playlists over a stable WiFi connection

title: Recovering Deleted Playlists & Library Management
summary: How to restore accidentally deleted playlists and troubleshoot missing saved songs.
diagnostic_steps: Log in to your account page at spotify.com/account on a web browser
Select 'Recover playlists' from the left navigation menu
Find the deleted playlist and click 'Restore'
Restart your Spotify app to see the restored playlist in Your Library

title: Clean Reinstall of Spotify App
summary: Standard operating procedure to eliminate corrupted configuration files causing crashes or freeze errors.
diagnostic_steps: Completely uninstall Spotify from your device application manager
Delete residual application data (on Windows: %localappdata%\Spotify and %appdata%\Spotify)
Restart your computer or mobile device
Download and install the latest fresh version from spotify.com/download

title: Connecting to Bluetooth, Alexa & External Speakers
summary: Troubleshooting Spotify Connect, Bluetooth pairing, and smart home voice integrations.
diagnostic_steps: Ensure both your device and speaker/smart device are connected to the exact same WiFi network
Unpair and re-pair Bluetooth connections on your phone/computer
In the Alexa / Google Home app, unlink Spotify Skill and re-link with your Spotify credentials
Restart both your playback device and your smart speaker or router

title: Music Availability, Regional Rights & Greyed Out Tracks
summary: Information regarding artist music rights, territorial availability, and catalog licensing updates.
diagnostic_steps: Music availability is determined by rightsholders (record labels and artists) and varies by country
If an album is greyed out, licensing agreements in your region may have expired or changed
Enable 'Show unplayable songs' in desktop settings to view track status
Check our Spotify Community New Releases board for catalog release announcements

title: Ad Frequency & Reporting Inappropriate Ads
summary: Policy regarding audio advertisement delivery, frequency caps, and commercial content reporting.
diagnostic_steps: Spotify Free is supported by audio, video, and banner ads to provide free listening
To report an ad with inappropriate audio (e.g. sirens, jarring alarms), note the advertiser and time
Upgrade to Spotify Premium to enjoy completely ad-free uninterrupted streaming
If you are a paid Premium subscriber hearing ads, log out and log back in to refresh account status

title: Spotify Community Ideas & Feature Feedback
summary: How to submit, vote on, and track feature requests with Spotify's product and engineering teams.
diagnostic_steps: Visit the Spotify Community Idea Submissions board at community.spotify.com
Search to see if another user has already proposed your feature or UI improvement
Add your vote and feedback to existing ideas to help our product team prioritize development
If not found, submit a new idea with use case details
